inspectionOrder: Opened original 0499 and 0527, desktop/mobile game baseline, exported desktop/mobile/state/component previews, corrected context patch and re-exported/reopened desktop/mobile, then edited Runtime.
referenceDecision: The newer 2023 image 0527 uses a small book entrance at lower left; 2021 image 0499 has a clearer vertical task pennant and matches the existing navigation design context. Both are historical variants, not verified current S1 UI. Use 0499 for the bounded pennant composition, not a claim that this is the latest official style.
findings: The 354x174 paper card and large building medallion are replaced by a 56x120 task pennant, a separately readable current objective, progress strip and 132x44 action.
The total blocked footprint is now 354x120, 31.03 percent shorter. The default objective remains visible and every actionable region is at least 44 logical units in both dimensions.
Desktop and independently laid-out mobile previews show the same hierarchy. Mobile preview exports at 1600x729 from the 1800x820 logical safe-area canvas, not a device screenshot.
Active, claimable and completed examples retain distinct live text and real progress semantics; no numbers or Chinese text are baked into the production components.
An initial context crop accidentally duplicated a city name. The crop was moved to a map-only area, re-exported and visually rechecked before Runtime implementation.
The map patch, baseline, earlier header and footer are design context only. Their composition is not a new runtime camera image and is never imported into game assets.

Fine ornament, calligraphic official lettering and current-S1 independent artwork are not available; they were not invented or claimed restored. Runtime transparency and actual Chinese font metrics still require publisher review.
